scope: Independent CPU recomputation from two complete typed compiled benchmark logs
checks: Every series contains 31 finite, positive timing samples.
Medians and nearest-rank p90 values were independently recomputed at sorted indices 15 and 27 and match the printed precision.
All 12 median ratios agree with the raw samples within the printed precision.
All 12 compiled programs start with zero traces and end with exactly one trace.
Both logs finish with six cases, two paths and all measured outputs validated.
All 106 source hashes, the source archive manifest and the release binary remain unchanged after both complete runs.
These wall measurements do not establish GPU execution time or the contribution of a particular fusion.
